scripts.build: npm run build -w @ccm/shared && npm run build -w @ccm/server && npm run build -w @ccm/client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @ccm/shared && npm run dev -w @ccm/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ccm/shared && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=server/tsconfig.json node --import tsx --test shared/test/*.test.ts server/test/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ccm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ccm/server && npm run typecheck -w @ccm/client
